name: Watson-kun
source:
The side character of the local anime, [url=https://vndb.org/c77646]Choco-tan[/url]!

When the mystery prevents to discover all truths, the great Choco-tan and her assistant Watson-kun are in charge of finding impossible answers and to stop the bad ones to send them in prison!

[spoiler]Character created by [url=https://vndb.org/c1530]Chiyoko[/url].[/spoiler]
